package model

import "testing"

// Every constructor is compared against the mapping a person would have
// written, member for member. Not a golden file: a golden file says the output
// has not changed, and what makes a constructor right is that it moves the
// values a person meant to move.

func byHandPerson(src *User) Person {
	return Person{
		ID:       src.ID,
		Email:    src.Email,
		Age:      src.Age,
		FullName: src.FullName(),
		Nickname: src.NickName(),
	}
}

func TestPersonAgreesWithTheHandWrittenOne(t *testing.T) {
	src := User{ID: 7, Email: "a@b", Age: 40}
	if got, want := PersonFromUser(&src), byHandPerson(&src); got != want {
		t.Errorf("the constructor built %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
}

// reader is a Reader the test brings, since an interface holds no values of
// its own.
type reader struct {
	id    int
	label string
}

func (r reader) ID() int       { return r.id }
func (r reader) Label() string { return r.label }

func byHandCard(src Reader) Card {
	return Card{ID: src.ID(), Label: src.Label()}
}

func TestCardAgreesWithTheHandWrittenOne(t *testing.T) {
	src := reader{id: 3, label: "ace"}
	if got, want := CardFromReader(src), byHandCard(src); got != want {
		t.Errorf("the constructor built %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
}

func byHandRenamed(src *User) Renamed {
	return Renamed{ID: src.ID, Moniker: src.Email}
}

func TestTheHintSettlesRenamed(t *testing.T) {
	src := User{ID: 5, Email: "m@n", Age: 1}
	if got, want := RenamedFromUser(&src), byHandRenamed(&src); got != want {
		t.Errorf("the constructor built %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
}

func byHandConverted(src *User) Converted {
	return Converted{Age: float64(src.Age)}
}

func TestTheHintConvertsConverted(t *testing.T) {
	src := User{Age: 33}
	if got, want := ConvertedFromUser(&src), byHandConverted(&src); got != want {
		t.Errorf("the constructor built %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
}

func byHandTitled(src *Entitled) Titled {
	return Titled{ID: src.ID, title: src.Title}
}

func TestTheLocalUnexportedMemberIsMoved(t *testing.T) {
	src := Entitled{ID: 2, Title: "dr"}
	if got, want := TitledFromEntitled(&src), byHandTitled(&src); got != want {
		t.Errorf("the constructor built %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
}

func byHandSparse(src *Terse) Sparse {
	return Sparse{ID: src.ID}
}

func TestTheIgnoredMemberStaysZero(t *testing.T) {
	src := Terse{ID: 9}
	if got, want := SparseFromTerse(&src), byHandSparse(&src); got != want {
		t.Errorf("the constructor built %+v, want %+v", got, want)
	}
}
